definition: not given to gentleness or soft feelings
description: A young boxer stands in a dim boxing gym with punchbags and other fighters training behind him. His grey shirt is soaked through with a big dark patch of sweat down the chest, his face and hair are wet, and he talks straight into the camera between hard breaths without softening. At the end he lifts a white towel with hands wrapped in red boxing wraps and rubs it over his head.

taps.phrase: to talk straight into the camera

en.question: What is he doing with the towel?

de.answer: Er trocknet sich mit dem Handtuch die Haare.

es.answer: Se está secando el pelo con la toalla.
